jobs.description:
Our client is a leading industrial manufacturing company investing in the expansion and modernization of one of its production sites.

Jobomschrijving

• Coordinate engineering activities from concept and feasibility studies through execution.
• Act as the interface between engineering, production, and project management teams.
• Support the delivery of multidisciplinary installations, including civil works, mechanical equipment, utilities, and electrical systems.
• Monitor project planning, technical coordination, and execution to ensure objectives are met.
• Contribute to the successful implementation of brownfield CAPEX projects within an operational production environment.

• Master's or Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, or a multidisciplinary engineering background with a strong civil engineering foundation.
• Proven experience as a Project Engineer on industrial CAPEX projects, ideally in brownfield environments.
• Strong understanding of civil engineering with the ability to coordinate multidisciplinary technical activities.
• Excellent coordination and communication skills, with the ability to work across multiple stakeholders.
• Fluent in Dutch and English (mandatory).

Are you ready for a new challenge where your expertise can truly make a difference?
 

If you have a Scientific degree and experience in Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field, this is your opportunity to be part of something bigger than yourself. As an Operations Expert, you'll play a key role in manufacturing advanced cell therapies that are transforming cancer treatment and giving patients new hope.
 

Every day, your work will directly contribute to delivering life-changing therapies to patients facing serious diseases. Join a passionate team united by a shared purpose: creating innovative treatments and improving lives around the world.
 

Your key responsibilities:
 

 
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.
 
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
 
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
 
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
 
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste. 

Who we are looking for:
 

 
• You have obtained at least a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
 
• Cell experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
 
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
 
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
 
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
 
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

Are you looking for a meaningful job where you contribute daily to improving the lives of patients with life-threatening diseases? As a Lab Technician you will work with a passionate team to develop groundbreaking therapies and make a real difference for patients worldwide.
 

Your key responsibilities:

• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
 
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
 
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
 
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste. 

Who we are looking for:
 

 
• You have obtained a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
 
• Cell culture experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
 
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
 
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
 
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
 
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

jobs.description:
Do you speak Polish, German, and English?Do you enjoy helping people and gain energy from phone-based customer contact and administrative tasks? In this Customer Service Representative role, you will support customers who need assistance when their vehicle breaks down. You ensure clear communication and provide fast, effective solutions.
Wij bieden
A gross salary starting from €2,500 per month, supplemented with:

• Meal vouchers
• 12 additional leave (ADV) days
• After the temporary employment period: group insurance and hospitalization insurance
• A 3-month training program upon joining (8:00 AM – 4:30 PM)
• After training: shifts between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM with a 30-minute break
• A small team environment with direct support
• A varied role with plenty of customer interactionWij vragen
• You speak and write Polish, German, and English fluently to assist our customers effectively.
• You are comfortable working with computer systems and can multitask.
• You have strong communication skills and can handle phone calls and emails professionally.
• You are solution-oriented and always strive to provide the best support to customers.Het bedrijf
Our client helps drivers and transport companies get their vehicles back on the road quickly in the event of a breakdown or mechanical issue. You will work in a small team where communication is direct and straightforward. The organization operates internationally, and you will interact daily with a wide variety of people and profiles. The company is located in Hasselt.

.

Do you enjoy physical work and don't mind working in a cold environment? Are you comfortable working in the meat industry (pork)? Then this opportunity could be perfect for you!

For our client’s deboning department, we are looking for a motivated employee with experience as a butcher, meat deboner, or within the meat processing industry.Your Profile

• Experience as a butcher, deboner, or within the meat industry is a strong asset.
• You are motivated and enjoy hands-on work.
• You preferably speak and understand at least two of the following languages: Dutch, English, or Polish.
• If you speak one of these languages well, you are also welcome to apply.
• You work accurately and have an eye for quality.

Your Responsibilities

• Deboning and processing pork products.
• Working according to quality, hygiene, and safety standards.
• Cooperating with colleagues in a production environment.
• Keeping your workplace clean, organized, and safe.

As a quality control associate, you will inspect incoming and outgoing goods. You will verify quantities, record data, and follow up on discrepancies in accordance with established procedures. If you identify damage, incorrect products, or incorrect quantities, you will report them and help find a solution. Your meticulous approach ensures that the quality of the goods and the logistics process are maintained.

 

• You work accurately and have an eye for detail

• You can work independently and take initiative when necessary

• You check and record figures quickly and accurately

• You communicate clearly in the event of damage, incorrect products, or discrepancies in quantities

• You can work according to established procedures

• You are available for a permanent late-shift position

• You are comfortable using a tablet

• You have a very good command of English, as communication with the team leader will be in English

Are you someone who enjoys working with precision and finds satisfaction in quality control? As a quality control associate, you’ll ensure that goods are properly inspected, counted, and recorded. You’ll maintain an overview, quickly identify discrepancies, and make sure everything is correct down to the smallest detail. You’ll work a fixed late shift from 2:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. 
Wij bieden
• Hourly wage of €15.64   7.5% shift premium
• Meal vouchers worth €10/day
• A quick start in a stable logistics environment
• Work hours on the late shift from 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM
• Varied tasks within quality control
• Clear procedures and a structured workflow
• On-the-job training
• Opportunities to advance to roles with greater responsibilityWij vragen
• You work accurately and have an eye for detail
• You can work independently and take initiative when necessary
• You check and record figures quickly and accurately
• You communicate clearly in the event of damage, incorrect products, or discrepancies in quantities
• You can work according to established procedures
• You are available for a permanent late-shift position
• You are comfortable using a tablet
• You have a very good command of English, as communication with the team leader will be in EnglishHet bedrijf
Our client operates in the logistics sector in Puurs. You’ll be working in an international environment where quality and the proper handling of goods are paramount. Colleagues support one another and work according to clear guidelines and procedures. This ensures that you always know what’s expected of you.

.

Company located in Roeselare

Jobomschrijving

You will be responsible for:

• Moving and dragging foam blocks
• Manually feeding the machine
• Picking up foam scraps from the floor
• Keeping the workplace clean and organized
• Working together with your colleague to ensure a smooth production process

• You speak Dutch or English.
• You are physically strong and enjoy active work.
• You can perform repetitive tasks accurately.
• You enjoy working together with a colleague.
• Experience is not required; motivation is more important.
• You can work in a day shift, and when production volumes increase, you are willing to work in a 2-shift system.

Company located in the Roeselare region.

Jobomschrijving

What are your responsibilities as a forklift driver?

• Receiving and correctly storing incoming goods in the warehouse
• Loading and unloading trucks
• Scanning products in and out using a scanning system
• Operating a forklift (approximately 80% of the time) and an electric pallet truck (approximately 20%)
• Maintaining a clean, safe, and organized workplace
• Working in a chilled environment with a closed and heated forklift

• You hold a valid forklift certificate
• You have experience stacking and working at heights of up to 10 meters
• You speak Dutch, French, or English
• You work accurately and value order and structure
• Safety is always your top priority
• You enjoy working independently but also function well within a team

Het bedrijf is een dynamische onderneming in Izegem, actief in de voedings- en verssector. Ze bieden een breed assortiment kwaliteitsproducten en zetten sterk in op klantgerichtheid en service. Hier werken betekent deel uitmaken van een hecht team dat vakmanschap en betrouwbaarheid hoog in het vaandel draagt.

Jobomschrijving

For our client, a family-run and growing company based in IZEGEM, we are looking for a production worker to strengthen the team. Do you enjoy working with fresh products, are you precise, and not afraid to work in a cooled environment? Then keep reading!

Your responsibilities:

• Cleaning, cutting, and packaging fruits and vegetables
• Working according to hygiene and quality standards
• Contributing to a smooth production flow
• You’ll work in a cooled environment of around 7°C, with appropriate clothing provided
Working hours (full-time):

• Monday: off
• Tuesday to Friday: 7:00 AM – 1:00 PM and 1:30 PM – 4:00 PM
• Saturday: 6:00 AM – 12:25 PM

• You speak Dutch or English
• You work accurately and hygienically
• Previous experience in the food industry is a plus, but not required
• You are physically fit and motivated

As a Press Line Machine Operator, you are responsible for operating the equipment on the press line, ensuring that the clay is shaped and compacted to the correct form and density before the bricks enter the kiln.  Your Key Responsibilities:

• Preparing the production line according to the planned production schedule.

• Setting up and changing over the equipment to meet the required specifications.

• Operating the production line and monitoring/adjusting parameters in accordance with established procedures.

• Managing the loading and unloading of the drying chambers.

• Replenishing the hood kiln.

• Monitoring and adjusting the quality of the bricks produced.

• Recording production data and technical observations.

• Carrying out minor maintenance tasks and ensuring a clean and tidy working environment. 

Who Are You?

 

• You have a technical qualification or a strong technical aptitude.

• You have a basic understanding of automated equipment and systems.

• You have several years of experience as a machine operator or in operating more complex equipment, preferably in a production environment.

• You are fluent in Dutch and/or English.

• You are willing to work day shifts, starting at 7:30 a.m.

An organisation operating in the industrial/manufacturing industry based in Wijnegem. Accessible by car and public transportation.

Jobomschrijving

As a Supply Chain Officer your responsibilities are:

• Coordinate procurement activities to ensure timely delivery of goods and services.
• Monitor inventory levels and manage stock replenishment processes effectively.
• Ensure compliance with procurement policies and procedures.
• Collaborate with internal departments to forecast demand and plan supply accordingly.
• Organizing transportation of raw materials and finished goods.
• Analyse and optimise supply chain processes to improve efficiency.
• Handle documentation and administrative tasks related to procurement and supply chain management.

A successful Supply Chain Officer should have:

• A strong understanding of procurement and supply chain processes.
• Experience in the industrial/manufacturing sector is beneficial.
• Excellent organisational and problem-solving skills.
• Strong communication and negotiation abilities.
• Professional proficiency in English and French. 
• Attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.

The company is located in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As a Finance Officer your responsibilities are:

• Manage daily financial transactions and maintain accurate records.
• Prepare and review financial statements and reports.
• Ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards.
• Support month-end and year-end financial closing processes.
• Collaborate with internal teams to manage budgets and forecasts.
• Monitor accounts payable and receivable processes.
• Assist in audits and implement recommendations as required.
• Provide financial analysis and insights to support decision-making.

A successful Finance Officer should have:

• Educational background in accounting, finance, or a related field.
• Residence in Brussels/Belgium.
• Valid EU work permit.
• Proficiency in financial software and tools.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Attention to detail and accuracy in financial reporting.
• Ability to communicate effectively in both English and French.

A professional services organisation based in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As a recruiter your responsibilities are:

• Source and attract candidates using various recruitment channels.
• Screen and shortlist applicants based on job requirements.
• Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers.
• Maintain and update recruitment databases and records.
• Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
• Provide support in contract preparation and onboarding processes.
• Collaborate with the HR team to meet recruitment goals.
• Ensure compliance with recruitment policies and procedures

• Bilingual in French and English (mandatory)
• Previous experience in recruitment is required
• Enjoys daily interaction with people while also appreciating administrative tasks
• Available immediately
• Temporary contract, with a potential opportunity for a permanent position

For a company in the Waregem area, I am looking for a polyvalent forklift driver.

Tasks:

• Operating gasoline-powered forklifts.
• Performing tasks without a forklift, such as hosing down trucks and containers.
• Working around live chickens.

• You have a lot of experience with a forklift.
• You are in possession of a valid forklift certificate.
• You are flexible in hours. You start at 5am, but end times varies.
• You want to work in the area of chickens
• We can count on you 
• You can speak sufficient English. French is a plus.
